critique.evidence: Strong dark security-lab art direction, dramatic headline, restrained cyan/amber accents, and clear desktop hierarchy. However, polish breaks across viewports: desktop metric values visibly clip at the card edge; mobile has severe horizontal clipping in the evidence button, alert copy, metric strip, table, audit text, and deployment decision. The mobile header also loses the product name and presents a cramped, partially visible navigation rail. Much supporting text is tiny and low-contrast, weakening legibility. Tablet is the most composed viewport but cannot offset the mobile failures.
critique.fix: Make the evidence panel truly responsive: remove fixed/min widths, wrap alert and audit text, stack metrics, preserve table columns through a deliberate card transformation or contained scroll treatment, and keep the evidence button fully inside its card. Reduce oversized desktop numerals, raise secondary-text contrast and size, and redesign the compact header so the brand and current section remain clearly visible.
